name: cc-limit-resume-codex
description: Rate-limit resume hook plugin for Codex CLI — detects rate-limit stops and arms sessions for explicit resume via codex exec resume.

interface.shortDescription: Detect rate-limit stops and arm sessions for explicit resume.
interface.longDescription: Captures Codex CLI Stop hook events, detects rate-limit stops by parsing assistant messages, and arms sessions for explicit one-shot resume via `codex exec resume`. This plugin does not auto-retry or bypass rate limits.
